concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies table / all tasks vs spec.md:FR-038, FR-039
concerns.text: No task covers FR-038 (data-model.md column definitions must exactly match contracts/stress_curves.schema.yaml, discrepancies resolved before pipeline execution) or FR-039 (data-model.md designated SSoT). Worse, data-model.md currently points at `src/pipeline/distort.py`, `src/pipeline/collapse.py`, `src/pipeline/train_regressor.py` while tasks build `code/distortion_engine.py`, `code/collapse.py`, `code/train_regressor.py` — no task reconciles the SSoT document with the actual module layout or the duplicate singular/plural contract files. Add a task to update data-model.md and designate canonical schemas.

FR-005 mandates the regression target be the Universal Collapse Intensity (FR-036), but T007's regression_input target is `inflection_step` (matching regression_input.schema.yaml). No task trains a regressor on the Universal Collapse Intensity, so FR-005's core mandate has no covering task. Align the target (spec's Universal Collapse Intensity) across T007, the contract, and data-model.md.

FR-033 requires regression predictions to be compared against the 500 expert-labeled curves to compute an out-of-sample R² ('independent check beyond the deterministic target'). T006 computes only precision/recall (SC-009); no task performs the FR-033 out-of-sample R² comparison of regression predictions against the expert ground truth.

SC-004 (pilot ≤ 48 h, full run ≤ 72 h on the GPU cluster) has no task or verification step that measures/records wall-time feasibility, and T004's in-task discretion to 'scale to a fixed-seed real subset' if the budget is exceeded leaves FR-002's ≥ 50,000 × 54 × 5 workload mandate without a guaranteed covering task or documented amendment trigger.

The dependency table row for T008 lists 'SC-005' but the task text tags only FR-006, SC-002, FR-051; conversely SC-003 (FDR-corrected interaction p-values) is only implicitly covered via T007's corrected_pvalues.json and is not named in any task's tags or the coverage table. Reconcile the table so every SC-001–SC-009 maps explicitly (SC-003, SC-004, SC-006 currently have no table row).
